test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The rate of simple interest for which ₹9,000 will amount to ₹10,200 in 4 years is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.9000

Amount = Rs.10200

Time = 4 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

Amount (A) = (S.I + P)

Where, P = principal; R = rate; T = time

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (A - P)

⇒ (10200 - 9000) = Rs.1200

Rate = (1200 × 100)/(9000 × 4)

⇒ (10/3) = 31over3 %

**∴ The correct answer is 31over3 %.**
